notes.title: Update 0.2c (including demo!)
notes.notes:
We've made the following changes to the full game and the demo is also up to date with this update and the previous updates.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]5 music tracks
[*]Toggle music on/off lantern
[*]Super sampling settings
[*]Some more nature elements
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Minimum ceiling height requirement (180 cm) to get on the Steam leaderboards to make it more fair for everyone. We're still working out how to balance the global competition, so we might reset the leaderboard at some point.
[*]Local scoreboard default name values
[*]An issue that made the text on the start screen unreadable. The text should now be more clear.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2a - Leaderboard, achievements and more!
notes.notes:
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]Global Steam leaderboard for Time Attack scores. The leaderboard is not actually visible in game yet, but is accessible in the Steam VR overlay under Achievements -> Leaderboards (and also in the Steam client). We ran into some issues trying to integrate the leaderboard in game, so we thought this was a good temporary solution. 
[*]13 new Steam Achievements. 
[*]Secondary controller added. Both controllers now work in the game.
[/list] 

[b]Changed/fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]We polished the dragon's movements. They now feel slightly smoother.
[*]Increased the threshold so the lanterns don't spawn as close to the HMD.
[*]A couple of other minor fixes.
[/list] 

[b]Coming next[/b]
[list]
[*]Music
[*]Ambient sounds
[*]Settings menu
[*]Zen leaderboard
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for future updates, feel free to write a community post or e-mail us at al@dreamcave.xyz. 

[u]Now go and become the world's number one Tails master![/u]

notes.title: Update 0.1b changelog
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

We've fixed most of the issues that users reported after the launch.

[b]Both the main game and the demo has been updated with the following changes[/b]

Added
[list]
[*] Audio cues on pickup lantern spawn
[*] Countdown time sound when timer is running out
[*] Combo time play space multiplier: The bigger the room, the longer before the combo runs out.
[/list]

Fixed
[list]
[*] Default ceiling height is automatically set to 180 cm the first time you run the game. Before the default value was set to 0 cm, which caused lanterns to spawn on the floor if the height was not manually set. 
[*] Navigation arrow powerup duration is now a little longer
[*] Turned down SuperSampling on start screen. Performance should be a lot better.
[/list]

Removed
[list]
[*] Time attack difficulties removed for balancing purposes. Now there is only a single time attack mode. Note that there was no actual difference before. The difficulties were just leftovers that was going to be removed anyways.
[/list]

[i]Note: You can set the games "ceiling" height in the start menu (and main menu) by pressing the shoulder button (above the trackpad). Further instructions are found to the right of the Tails logo in-game. This is also useful if you have kids playing. [/i]
